name: off_brief_delivery
description: A Seller submits a link, and the actually-fetched content is unrelated to the acceptance criteria. Confirms the adjudicator sides with the Buyer based on real retrieved evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A 500-word essay explaining how zero-knowledge proofs work, written for a non-technical audience.
mocked_evidence_fetch_result: A web page displaying a stock photograph of a mountain landscape at sunset with the caption 'nature is nice'. No text discussing zero-knowledge proofs, cryptography, or any technical topic appears anywhere on the page.
